earlyExit.intro: The review was not completed and the report is incomplete due to the following issues:

findings.message: The submitted source either could not be built by following its build instructions, or does not build into the submitted XPI, so the review cannot continue. Please make sure the build instructions are complete, that the build succeeds from a clean copy of the submitted archive, and that the submitted XPI is built from exactly the submitted source by those instructions.

A build dependency this add-on declares has known security vulnerabilities: lint-pebble (0.4.0) is affected by published advisories of critical severity (GHSA-fixture-pebble). It is not shipped, but reviewers build the add-on from source, so it runs on the reviewer's machine during the build. Update lint-pebble to 0.4.1 or later.
